protocol.origin: before period 1 of target day D
protocol.referenceLookup: calendar date + period, never positional shift
protocol.missingReferencePolicy: unavailable; no imputation or baseline substitution

selection.criterion: minimum MAE; practical tie => minimum RMSE; remaining tie => lexical ID

metricDefinitions.WAPE: 100 * sum(abs(error)) / sum(abs(actual)), paired evaluable observations only
metricDefinitions.WAPEComponentsUnit: COP/kWh summed over observations; not a daily price or monetary settlement
metricDefinitions.percentiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over sorted absolute errors
metricDefinitions.arithmetic: Python float (IEEE-754 double), math.fsum; no intermediate rounding
metricDefinitions.groupMetrics: same definitions applied independently by target period/weekday
